text:
jordan: Heads-up: a partner CI started consuming quota but shows up as "no-project" in console. Billing flagged it earlier today.
anya: I saw that too. Many of these are from our new sidecar exchange where claims get dropped if the svc account is ephemeral.
raul: quick check: does the sidecar rewrite Authorization or strip custom headers? We didn't account for forwarded provenance.
tess: sidecar strips unknown headers by default. we flipped a setting last week to harden upstreams.
kai: proposal: accept an opt-in header X-RW-Origin-Hint that token-service can set during exchange. precedence: signed header > token_provenance > key.owner > unattributed. we can encode confidence as level=0..3.
anya: please make sure the header is never sent to external upstreams. only internal routing should see it. add allowlist flag for forward_destinations.
raul: sample debug log we can add in auth-proxy:

{"req":"$REQ","chosen_origin":"project:77","origin_level":"1","rule":"provenance_header"}

tess: UX ask: console should show "best guess" owner with badge "hinted" and a link to "claim this usage". claim flow should present evidence: header, exchange trace, key metadata.
kai: telemetry metrics: rw.auth.origin.hints_total, rw.auth.origin.unattributed_pct, rw.auth.origin.conflict_count. emit event rw.auth.origin.inferred with fields used_rule and level.
anya: rollout plan: 1) feature-flag header from token-service (internal only) 2) auth-proxy reads + tags metrics (2% canary) 3) backfill attribution job for last 14d 4) console badge + claim modal 5) flip on billing-reconcile flag
raul: alert: page eng-platform if unattributed_pct > 1% for 10m AND total_rps > 2000. also create SLO doc for attribution quality.
tess: edge-case: partner proxies that reissue tokens — we must detect multi-hop and avoid double-counting. add exchange_chain length to provenance header.
infra-bot: deployed feature-flag scaffold: token-service provenance header behind flag TF-3979.
jordan: will open an RFC with the precedence table, sample header format, and mockups. tagging reviewers: @anya @raul @tess @kai :thumbsup:
